subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — quiet window needed
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <pri.s@orchidai.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Hi Logan —

We self-signed up and were routed to the Dedicated capacity track. Our infra team needs to validate performance for a high-throughput workload (see attached QPS matrix). We have a constraint: monthly backup windows run every night 02:00-04:00 local PT and we cannot run noisy load tests then. Can we schedule a live demo + throughput run during a daytime quiet window next week (preferably Thu or Fri morning)? Also want to bring our infra lead (Priya) to validate KV cache behavior.

Attached: orchid-qps-matrix.xlsx, capacity_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. Platform Engineer
Orchid AI

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the QPS matrix — that helps a lot.

Quick plan: we can do a 45-minute walkthrough of Dedicated (how routing, batching, and KV caching work) + 30 minutes of an on-demand throughput run against a pinned model variant. I proposed two windows on my Calendly: Thu 19 Jun 09:00 PT or Fri 20 Jun 10:00 PT. Can you confirm which works for you and Priya?

Notes for the run:
- We'll run synthetic traffic with your approximate token lengths (per spreadsheet).
- We'll need a stable test harness on your side for 10–15 minutes during the run to validate latency percentiles.
- We will not schedule the run during 02:00–04:00 PT backups.

If those slots don't work, tell me a target window and Ben (cc'd, SDR) can help get a calendar match.

Best,
Logan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Book: https://calendly.com/logan-wright/30m

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <pri.s@orchidai.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Hey Logan —

Thanks. Thu 19 Jun 09:00 PT is perfect. Priya will join. A couple of asks before the call:

1) Can you confirm we won't do any aggressive node-level fault injection during the demo? We want an apples-to-apples throughput read.
2) Will Redwood provision a short-lived dedicated pool for the run, or will this be routed to shared infra? We prefer an isolated pool for accurate P99 latency.

I attached a short internal runbook (orchid-runbook.txt) — just for context.

Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Alex — looping in operations and a quick checklist.

TL;DR: we can do an isolated pool for the run and will avoid fault injection.

Checklist: 
- Isolated test pool: yes (we'll provision a 3-GPU pool pinned to your demo).
- Duration: 20-minute steady-state run + 10-minute ramp down.
- Payload: we'll use the token lengths from orchid-qps-matrix.xlsx unless you want a different sampler.
- Monitoring: we'll share a live dashboard and token-level latency breakdown.

Logan/priyom — can you confirm the pool size and which model variant we should pin? Priyom: any recommendations on qps targeting given their matrix?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>, Priya Shah <pri.s@orchidai.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Thanks Ben — I recommend a 3xA10 pool for the initial run (matches typical QPS targets in their spreadsheet). Suggest we pin the inference to model-redwood-v2-7b-int8 for latency cost balance. We'll start with 5k qps target for the steady-state and then step up to 8k for a 5-minute spike to observe cache behavior.

Also: Alex — to be safe, can you confirm the exact timezone on your side and the name of the test harness you'll use to emit requests? We'll send a pre-call checklist (simple curl commands + timestamp sync verification) to ensure timings line up.

Priyom
Senior Infra Strategist, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orchidai.com>, Priya Shah <pri.s@orchidai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request: throughput + quiet-window constraints

Perfect — all set for Thu 19 Jun 09:00 PT. Summary / action items: 

- Meeting: Thu 19 Jun 09:00–10:15 PT (45m walkthrough + 30m throughput run). Calendar invite sent (attached as .ics stub).
- Infra: Redwood will provision a 3-GPU isolated pool pinned to model-redwood-v2-7b-int8.
- Test plan: steady-state 5k qps for 20 minutes, 5-minute spike to 8k, no fault injection.
- Pre-call: Alex to confirm timezone and test harness name; Redwood will send pre-call curl samples and dashboard link.
- Attachments: orchid-qps-matrix.xlsx, capacity_requirements.pdf, demo-invite.ics (attachment stub).

Looking forward to it — I'll circulate the invite and pre-call checklist by EOD.

Best,
Logan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
